azure.frontdoor_classic.frontend_host.note: Classic: each frontend host (custom domain) beyond the 100 included

azure.frontdoor_classic.routing_rule_ove.note: Classic: each routing rule beyond 5, per hour

azure.frontdoor_classic.routing_rules.note: Classic: the first 5 routing rules together, per hour

azure.frontdoor_classic.transfer_in.note: Classic: data transfer from clients to the edge, the same in every zone

azure.frontdoor_classic.zone1.transfer_o.note: Classic: data transfer from the edge to clients in billing Zone 1 (North America, Europe, Middle East and Africa). Volume tiers count the transfer of every classic Front Door to the zone in a month: from 10 TB and 50 TB; the pricing page does not say whether the tiers count per Front Door, per region or per subscription, so they are pooled per region
